full.description: This is a high-power light micrograph of brain tissue showing neuropathological changes. The section reveals brain parenchyma with prominent perivascular inflammatory infiltrates and microglial nodules. These findings are characteristic of viral encephalitis, such as that seen in HIV-associated neurological disease.

random.description: This is a high-magnification micrograph of brain tissue stained with hematoxylin and eosin. The section shows cerebral parenchyma with prominent blood vessels exhibiting perivascular inflammatory infiltrates and multinucleated giant cells. These histopathological findings are characteristic of HIV encephalitis or HIV-associated neuropathy within the central nervous system. The surrounding neuropil demonstrates reactive changes and microglial nodule formation.
